name: Brussels Airport

runway.v: longest runway 07L/25R, 3,638 m long and 45 m wide (three runways in all)

curfew.v: no full night closure, but take-off and landing by marginally compliant (noisier) aircraft is forbidden 2200-0459 UTC in winter (2100-0359 UTC in summer), i.e. about 23:00-06:00 local; night noise-quota rules also apply
curfew.quote: Take-off or landing of marginally compliant aircraft is forbidden between 2200 and 0459 (2100 and 0359).

slots.v: a coordinated airport; general and business aviation must request slots through a handling agent, not directly from the coordinator
slots.quote: Slot requests sent directly to the coordinator will not be accepted.

notes: Curfew is a noise-class ban, not a closure: describe it as such. AIP times appear as UTC with summer UTC in brackets (e.g. 2200-0459 (2100-0359)); the bracket convention was not quoted from GEN 2.1, so the local conversion (23:00-05:59 local in both seasons) carries that caveat. The runway quote joins the designation and dimensions cells of the AD 2.12 table. Slot sentence on GA/BA via handling agent: AIP reads 'airport slots and airport slot authorization number must be requested only via a handling agent' (unless agreed otherwise with Belgium Slot Coordination). AIP read from skeyes eAIP_Main (current edition); the page did not display an AIRAC date in the text read. Night QC limits per movement were not reached in readable form.
